campaign.title: Test paired-offset cancellation in the exact M1 odd kernel

conductor_policy.monitoring: Pair n near X only through exact identities. Audit divisor-set mismatch, d-dependent arguments, integer/noninteger centers, and hard endpoint. Reject artificial symmetry.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after an exact paired-offset formula, a stability estimate or capacity obstruction, and a blind/hostile validation.

numerical_purpose: falsify offset symmetry on exact finite fibers
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Finite pairing tests cannot prove the asymptotic estimate.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only for an imported shifted-divisor or correlation theorem.

frozen_target.pairing_question: For offsets t>0, compare C(X-t;X)+C(X+t;X) when meaningful, including floor/ceiling conventions for nonintegral X. Determine whether divisor-set stability and oddness yield the required H/L saving.
frozen_target.success: Prove a new M1 residual region, reduce to a precise shifted-divisor correlation lemma, or rigorously show naive offset pairing lacks capacity.

campaign.promotion_policy: Oddness of V alone is not cancellation unless the weighted divisor fibers at opposite offsets are quantitatively matched.
